resumo: Web system to check availability and book labs and equipment, with automated tests.

estudoDeCaso.problema: Booking labs and equipment without a central system leads to schedule conflicts and manual control. The project also tested how to build a working app with AI agents following good engineering practices.
decisoes: TypeScript end to end, with React for the interface and SQLite as a simple database with no separate server.
Plan before code: scope split into small stories with acceptance criteria.
Test-first: every behavior change starts with a failing test.
Validation gate with typecheck, lint, build, tests and E2E before calling anything done.
estudoDeCaso.resultado: Local system with availability search, bookings with schedule conflict detection, filters, cancellation and event history.
estudoDeCaso.aprendizado: Using tests, planning and review to stay in control of code written with AI agents.
